entities.summary: Paul Gösch, also Goesch or Göschen, was a German artist, architect, lithographer, and designer of the early twentieth century; he was associated with the main elements of German Expressionism. Paul Goesch was a architects & engineers from Schwerin (1885-08-30, Schwerin–1940-08-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
